items.paraphrase: In residential apartment buildings (group R2) the main stair and its landing must be at least 1.2 m clear; the landing may not be narrower than the flight.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 from a rendered page image of the Arabic PDF

items.paraphrase: In villas (group R3) the main stair and landing need only 0.9 m clear.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 from a rendered page image of the Arabic PDF

items.paraphrase: Ramps in the means of egress may be no steeper than 1 in 12.
